entries.subject: Porter 2025 Styx shape fit
entries.finding: Presentation slide 9 gives full axes 10.6 × 6.0 × 5.3 km and a 7.0 km equivalent diameter. The package retains those axes as an approximate ellipsoid, without renormalization or local relief; the newer fit has no unique pole.

entries.subject: Weaver 2016 older Styx dimensions
entries.finding: The earlier 16 × 9 × 8 km fit is superseded for geometry. The historical pole and reported 3.24-day period remain illustrative/informational; they do not establish a current rotational phase.
entries.revisitWhen: A source reconciliation justifies replacing the 2025 dimensions or separately qualifying the historical geometry.

entries.subject: LORRI U_TBD_1_02 native frame lor_0299137075
entries.finding: The retained survey sorted 2,605 observations; the best six were approximately 3.125–3.133 km/native pixel. The inspected calibrated FITS has only a few source pixels across Styx and no controlled cartographic footprint.
entries.revisitWhen: A resolved, independently registered Styx observation supports actual surface information.

entries.subject: MVIC surface-geometry inventory
entries.finding: The recorded PDS search returned no indexed Styx observations, and the cited resolved-observation log lists LORRI only. This is an index-specific result, not proof of archive-wide absence.
entries.revisitWhen: A Styx-specific MVIC product or a new archive route establishes usable data and geometry.

entries.subject: NASA/Weaver six-image composite
entries.finding: The published composite is enlarged eight times beyond native spacing after deconvolution. It is useful context but does not supply eight times more independent surface detail or a qualified projection.
entries.revisitWhen: Native observations and controlled coordinates support a photographic surface independently of display enlargement.

entries.subject: USGS, PDS shape and HST source review
entries.finding: The retained source review located no usable Styx map, scalar field or downloadable controlled mesh. HST detections and lightcurves constrain orbit or shape, not local terrain.
entries.revisitWhen: A numerical target-specific model or mapped field with usable coordinates and uncertainty is located.
